title: S'more Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Designed with efficiency in mind, the ‘S’more’ cottage delivers much more than a typical one-bedroom, one-bath vacation home, supplemented by towering ceilings and advantageous attention to detail.
description_expanded: 20 Savannah StreetA Thoughtfully Designed Seaside Guest CottageDesigned with efficiency and creativity in mind, S’more Cottage offers far more than a typical one-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath vacation rental in Seaside, Florida. With soaring ceilings, smart use of space, and refined architectural details, this two-story cottage delivers a comfortable and stylish coastal retreat. Located directly across the street from the beach, S’more Cottage serves as the private guesthouse to Never Enough, while maintaining its own distinct footprint on Seaside’s east side.Open Living Spaces with Smart DesignThe first floor welcomes guests into an open living and dining area perfectly sized for a relaxing beach getaway. High ceilings create an airy feel, enhancing the sense of space and natural light. A comfortable twin sleeper sofa provides additional flexibility for guests, while the thoughtful layout ensures both function and comfort throughout the home.Efficient Kitchen for Coastal LivingThe compact yet well-appointed kitchen is designed for convenience and ease. Featuring mostly stainless-steel appliances, the kitchen includes a stovetop, compact dishwasher, and a refrigerator with a built-in wine rack, along with ample storage for extended stays. A half bath and a full-size washer and dryer are also located on the first floor, making day-to-day living effortless.Private King Loft RetreatUpstairs, the second-floor loft serves as a serene sleeping space with room for a king-sized bed and a full bathroom with shower and separate vanity. Surrounded by windows, the loft is filled with natural light and opens onto a private balcony, offering a quiet outdoor escape just steps from the Gulf.Please note: The second-floor king loft does not have a railing behind the headboard and is not suitable for young children.Outdoor Comfort & Flexible AccommodationsGuests enjoy the convenience of a private outdoor shower, ideal after a day on Seaside’s white-sand beaches. For larger groups or extended family stays, the neighboring three-bedroom main cottage, Never Enough, may also be rented to create additional space while maintaining privacy.A Recognized Seaside GemCharming, efficient, and memorable, S’more Cottage has even been featured in Designing for Small Homes, highlighting its thoughtful architecture and clever use of space. Whether enjoyed on its own or paired with the main cottage, this Seaside retreat offers a unique blend of design, comfort, and unbeatable beach proximity.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESFeatures 520 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space on the east side of Seaside, FloridaSeaside Private Residential Beach access at Savannah Pavilion1-minute walk (115 feet) to beach accessPrivate guesthouse to Never EnoughWasher and dryer included for added conveniencePeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the cottageFlat-screen TVs with built-in DVD playersPrivate outdoor shower, ideal after a day at the beachCompact refrigerator with wine rack and stovetop cooktopTwin sleeper sofa for additional sleeping accommodationsAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass issued per one-bedroom cottage(A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.)No pets allowedSTR23-001962
